description: This Java source file defines the 'DeleteAttribute' command class which provides functionality to delete a specific attribute from a 'Thing' entity within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes detailed methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, validation of attribute pointers, and JSON serialization. The class is part of command handling for modifying 'Thing' attributes.

classes.name: DeleteAttribute
classes.description: Represents a command to delete a specific attribute from a 'Thing'. Provides methods for instantiation from parameters or JSON, validation, and serialization, and overrides equality, hash code, and string representation methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DeleteAttribute command instance from ThingId, JsonPointer, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteAttribute command instance from a JSON string or object and headers.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the attribute to be deleted.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing to be modified.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path JSON pointer for this delete operation.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into JSON, respecting the schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new DeleteAttribute instance with the specified headers.
